notes.title: Ver. 1.10 Update
notes.notes:
Today we have a little update for everyone looking forward to Giraffe And Annika!

Update Contents

Added「Reload most recent recovery point.」function to the pause menu.
Added the following message before the Goddess Dance event.
「By performing the dance and progressing the story, there will be collectibles that will no longer be accessible. We recommend you create a separate save file before progressing.」
Various minor bug fixes.

notes.title: Ver. 1.02 Update
notes.notes:
For all those playing Giraffe And Annika, we've released an update!

Update Contents

 Motion blur can now be turned ON/OFF in Options
 Digital pad can now be used to move the character
 Various user-reported bugs preventing progression and causing the character to get stuck have also been fixed
